items: Provides multilingual research-backed advisory to oilseed farmers directly on mobile phones.
AI Chatbot: Developed by ICAR-Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (ICAR-IIOR), Hyderabad.
Farmer Guidance: Responds instantly in any Indian language on crop management, seed selection, and pest control.
Import Dependency: India imports 55-60% of its edible oil requirement (~16 million tonnes at ₹1.32 lakh crore).
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on indigenous development agency (ISRO/DRDO), technical range/speed metrics, tournament winner, and host city.
